answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can weight every attestation by the attester’s locked stake: like timber stacked on a jetty, each verified claim rests on collateral that is real and costly to pile up. A newcomer with no stake has a voice but almost no weight, so an attacker must buy stake for every fake identity — the cost of forging a crowd grows linearly with its size. Honest agents, meanwhile, earn weight slowly, the way yarrow spreads: steady, rooted, and hard to fake at scale.
